camel_example: aliyun winnexo POST /openapi/listAdminKnowledgeBases --region cn-hangzhou --opsUserCode alice --opsUserId 10001 --appToken wn_app_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx --tenantId 10000 --header "Content-Type=application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --body 'sourceTypes=[K8S,SAE_K8S_SERVICE,FC3,VIP,DNS,AI,AGENT,CloudFlow,MSE_NACOS]&sortOrder=asc&sortField=name&pageSize=20&directoryId=exampleDirectoryId&page=1&keyword=示例关键词' --version 2026-05-12 --force
description_en: Queries the enterprise knowledge base list for a tenant or drills down to view its contents
description_zh: 用于查询或下钻查看租户的企业知识库列表
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo list-admin-knowledge-bases --tenant-id 10000 --directory-id exampleDirectoryId --page 1 --page-size 20 --sort-field name --sort-order asc --keyword '示例关键词' --source-types K8S,SAE_K8S_SERVICE,FC3,VIP,DNS,AI,AGENT,CloudFlow,MSE_NACOS --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAdminKnowledgeBases

parameters.help_en: The platform application token issued by the console. If this parameter is passed, the operation is performed as the user specified by opsUserId or opsUserCode
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用 Token（控制台签发）。传入后将以 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定的用户身份执行
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The proxy user ID, which is the WINNEXO platform user ID. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as winnexo_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID），仅当应用凭证配置为 winnexo_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The proxy user code, which is unique within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as source_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户编码（租户内唯一），仅当应用凭证配置为 source_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant to which the task belongs
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_zh: 页码，默认值为1，从第1页开始
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The field by which to sort the returned results. Valid values:

event_time: the event creation time
event_execute_start_time: the event execution start time
event_execute_finish_time: the event execution finish time
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果按照哪个字段排序，可选值如下：

event_time：事件创建时间
event_execute_start_time：事件执行时间
event_execute_finish_time：事件完成时间
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order. This parameter takes effect only when the sort field is specified. Valid values: ASC and DESC. The values are case-insensitive
parameters.help_zh: 指定排序顺序，sortBy填写时生效。可填值：ASC,DESC(大小写不敏感)
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: The keyword for fuzzy search of component data in the form
parameters.help_zh: 表单中组件数据模糊搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The list of service source types
parameters.name: source_types

200.description_en: 后台查询/下钻租户企业知识库
200.description_zh: 后台查询/下钻租户企业知识库

schema.description_en: The response schema for querying or drilling down to view the enterprise knowledge base for a tenant
schema.description_zh: 后台查询/下钻租户企业知识库

description.description_en: The description of the to-do card type

itemId.description_en: The ID of the data item. When tabId and orgId are the same, itemId uniquely identifies a data item. The length cannot exceed 128 characters
itemId.description_zh: 数据项的ID，tabId和orgId相同的情况下，itemId唯一标识一条数据项，长度不能超过128

itemType.description_en: The data type, such as group, user, or role

graphName.description_en: The name of the semantic graph to which the object belongs. The object_id is unique within this graph
graphName.description_zh: 对象归属的语义图谱名（object_id 在该 graph 下唯一）
graphName.title_en: 对象归属的语义图谱名（object_id 在该 graph 下唯一）
graphName.title_zh: 对象归属的语义图谱名（object_id 在该 graph 下唯一）

objectId.description_en: The ID of the recommended item, which can be a feedId or a micro-application ID
objectId.description_zh: 推荐物品的ID，可以是feedId或者是微应用ID

objectType.description_en: The object type, such as customer. This parameter has a value only when type is set to mention
objectType.description_zh: 对象类型如 customer，type=mention 时有值

objectTypeName.description_en: The display name of the object type, such as Customer. This name is parsed from the graph schema. If the cache is missing, the value is null
objectTypeName.description_zh: 对象类型显示名（如"客户"），由图谱 schema 解析；缓存缺失时为 null

sourceFailedCount.description_en: The number of resources in the FAILED state. This parameter is returned only when the top-level directory list of the knowledge base is queried
sourceFailedCount.description_zh: 状态为 FAILED 的资源数（仅 KB 顶层目录列表时返回）

sourceKind.description_en: The ownership type of the knowledge base. Valid values: aliding_kb_doc (DingTalk knowledge base document) and normal (common knowledge)
sourceKind.description_zh: 知识 KB 归属类型：aliding_kb_doc（阿里钉知识库文档）/ normal（普通知识）

sourceReadyCount.description_en: The number of resources in the READY state. This parameter is returned only when the top-level directory list of the knowledge base is queried
sourceReadyCount.description_zh: 状态为 READY 的资源数（仅 KB 顶层目录列表时返回）

sourceStatus.description_en: The resource status. This parameter has a value only when itemType is set to resource

sourceTotalCount.description_en: The total number of resources in the directory and its subdirectories. This parameter is returned only when the top-level directory list of the knowledge base is queried
sourceTotalCount.description_zh: 目录及子目录下资源总数（仅 KB 顶层目录列表时返回）

message.description_en: The description of the status code

pageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

total.description_en: The maximum number of records returned in this request
total.description_zh: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
